Grouping follows the datasheet’s lane table (nominal wavelength + transmit wavelength ranges) and footnote 2 (per-lane bit rates). Per-lane max TX is +4.5 dBm; interface standard is 40GBASE-ER4. Aggregated rates (41.25 / 43.018 Gbps) and protocols (40GbE / OTU3) are module-wide and not paired to a single wavelength row, so they are not split into separate wavelength modes. No penalties appear in the output schema; optical path penalty is module-global.
